supporterView.description: One supporter of a creator. An anonymous supporter (tips whose record asked for it) never carries a DID.

totalUsd.description: Sum in US dollars with 2 decimals, eg '12.50'. USDC counts as one dollar; other assets at the indexer's current catalog price (assets without one count as 0).

tipCount.description: Number of verified tips and membership payments counted.

new30d.description: Members whose first paid period started in the last 30 days.

expired30d.description: Members whose membership ran out in the last 30 days and was not renewed.

now.description: Follower count from Krao's AppView (or, when it does not answer, follows by Krao accounts the indexer saw).

change30d.description: Net change over 30 days in follows by Krao accounts the indexer saw: new follows still in place, minus older follows removed. Absent when the indexer does not index follows.
